response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, entrepreneurial initiative with GISCollective, and exposure to AI-agent tooling, but lacks demonstrable AI/ML product ownership, cloud platform leadership at scale, and advanced AI education — key requirements for a director-level AI strategy role.
strengths: Proven entrepreneurial track record with open-source AI-adjacent platform (GISCollective)
Broad technical fluency across languages, cloud tools (AWS CDK, Docker, Kubernetes), and systems design
Active knowledge sharing and workshop leadership demonstrating communication and influence skills
concerns: No clear evidence of building or leading AI/ML products or platforms at scale
Lacks advanced degree in AI or related field; education is BS in CS only
Limited visibility into cloud architecture leadership or strategic customer advisory experience
